description: Main window. App db_* commands are allowed by default. allow-destroy lets the window close after pending saves finish (JRN-4). dialog save/open pick a backup to write or restore (EXP-4, EXP-5); opener reveals the data folder and log (EXP-7, DIST-6) and opens only the project's GitHub issues page in the browser (DIST-4); log:default lets the frontend write errors to the log file (DIST-6).
